title: reviewer output
description: One coordinate-reviewer pass over a retake plan and its situation report: at most eight ranked findings in four fixed classes, and a verdict. The rule that verdict fail requires a reserved finding is checked by tests/run_reviewer_sample.sh, since JSON Schema cannot express it here.

evidence.description: One or more pairs <json-path>: "<short quote>" joined by " / "; a path beginning with situation. points into the situation, any other into the plan; the quote is an exact substring of the value at that path, with an inner double quote written \".
